label: Unrestricted own-essence receipt strengthens identity-scoped receipt
meaning: The unrestricted law says any recipient of a being's esse is its essence. Under the restricted hypothesis that the being's esse equals its essence, that already supplies the identity-scoped law R3. No contingency, reception-existence premise, necessity, cause or priority is required. This is a formal strength relation, not additional philosophical confirmation of either OPEN premise. The narrower R3 is what the new B6 support actually uses.
